name: io.github.mobileproxy/mcp-server
description: Control dedicated 4G mobile and residential proxies on mobileproxy.space from AI agents.

environmentVariables.name: MOBILEPROXY_API_BASE
environmentVariables.description: Override REST API base URL (default https://mpsapi.com)

environmentVariables.name: MOBILEPROXY_DEBUG
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 for verbose stderr logs

environmentVariables.name: ADSPOWER_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: AdsPower Local API key, only if its security verification is on (for attach_proxy_to_adspower)

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <your mobileproxy.space API key>. Optional for clients that sign in with OAuth (claude.ai connectors).
